result.instructions: Tools for Submittable, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which submissions came in for our open grant project this week?"; "List the submissions with status in_progress and show who submitted each one."; "Show the answers in the latest form entry from this applicant.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Submittable data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run submittable_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run submittable_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run submittable_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. submittable_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: submittable_get_organization
tools.title: Get organization
tools.description: Get the organization that the API key belongs to: name, domain, account status and team capacity. Good first call to confirm the connection.

tools.name: submittable_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the organization's projects (calls for submissions) with their ids, names, start and end dates and live status. Use the `projectId` values in the other tools.

continuationToken.description: Continuation token from the previous page's `continuationToken` (omit for the first page).

size.description: Items per page (the API default applies when omitted).

tools.name: submittable_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Get one project by id: its name, dates, review stages, form ids and visibility settings.

projectId.description: Id as returned by another tool.

tools.name: submittable_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List forms (the submission forms of projects). Filter by form `type` or by `projectId`. Use the form ids in the form-entry tools.

continuationToken.description: Continuation token from the previous page's `continuationToken` (omit for the first page).

size.description: Items per page (the API default applies when omitted).

tools.name: submittable_get_form
tools.title: Get form
tools.description: Get one form by id: its name, type, fields and settings.

formId.description: Id as returned by another tool.

tools.name: submittable_list_submissions
tools.title: List submissions
tools.description: List submissions (one per submitter and project), with status, submitter name and email, title, labels and review stage. Filter by project, status, date and text. Submitter data is personal data: share it only as the user needs.

projectIds.description: Only submissions of these project ids.

labelIds.description: Only submissions that have at least one of these label ids.

continuationToken.description: Continuation token from the previous page's `continuationToken` (omit for the first page).

size.description: Items per page (the API default applies when omitted).

tools.name: submittable_get_submission
tools.title: Get submission
tools.description: Get one submission by id: status, submitter, title, labels, review stage and its form entries (the submitted answers and metadata).

submissionId.description: Id as returned by another tool.

tools.name: submittable_get_entry
tools.title: Get form entry
tools.description: Get one form entry by id: the answers a submitter gave on one form (initial, additional, internal, review or reference). Set `includeDrafts` to see unsent drafts.

entryId.description: Id as returned by another tool.

preferOriginalVersion.description: Return the submitted version, not the latest edit.

tools.name: submittable_list_form_entries
tools.title: List form entries
tools.description: List the completed form entries of one form (all submitters), one page at a time.

formId.description: Id as returned by another tool.

continuationToken.description: Continuation token from the previous page's `continuationToken` (omit for the first page).

size.description: Items per page (the API default applies when omitted).

tools.name: submittable_list_labels
tools.title: List labels
tools.description: List the labels the organization uses to tag submissions. Use the label ids in the submission filters.

continuationToken.description: Continuation token from the previous page's `continuationToken` (omit for the first page).

size.description: Items per page (the API default applies when omitted).

tools.name: submittable_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the organization's team members with their email, title, permission level and roles.
